claims.statement: Dotenv loads once with override=False, then GatewaySettings reads ReaLMM knobs while provider API keys remain in os.environ.
RuntimeFlagStore overlays only MEMORY, PII, GUARD, GUARD_INJECTION, and GUARD_CONTENT from data/runtime-flags.json and does not mutate os.environ.
Compose forces GATEWAY_ALLOW_OPEN=0, sets REDIS_URL to redis://redis:6379/0, binds published ports to loopback, and keeps the browser on http://127.0.0.1:8000.
